note: Bootstrap Datepicker provides one field widget plugin, bootstrap_date_widget (label 'Bootstrap Datepicker'), for core datetime fields (extends DateTimeWidgetBase), plus a bootstrap_datepicker render element. No admin UI (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no config schema, no config entities of its own. Configuration is per-field widget settings on the entity_form_display: core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type = bootstrap_date_widget and content.<field>.settings.<key>. Option keys mirror the JS plugin (format, language, week_start, start_view, autoclose, today_btn, clear_btn, start_date/end_date, days_of_week_disabled, etc). The actual popup needs the JS/CSS library at /libraries/bootstrap-datepicker (declared in bootstrap_datepicker.libraries.yml); that library is NOT installed on this site, but widget config still saves and is verifiable. All medium/hard cases create core datetime fields (field_bsd_*) on Article and read/write the bootstrap_date_widget selection + settings on the default form display, verified against live entity_form_display config (config-only; no JS execution required).

evals.prompt: In the Drupal bootstrap_datepicker module, what is the machine name of the field widget it provides, and which field type can it be used on?
evals.expected_output: The widget plugin id is bootstrap_date_widget (label 'Bootstrap Datepicker'); it applies to core 'datetime' fields and extends DateTimeWidgetBase. Select it on the field's Manage form display.

evals.prompt: Name several of the widget settings you can configure for the bootstrap_datepicker (Bootstrap Datepicker) widget in Drupal.
evals.expected_output: Settings mirror the JS plugin options: format (e.g. dd/mm/yyyy), language, week_start, start_view, min_view_mode/max_view_mode, autoclose, clear_btn, today_btn, today_highlight, calendar_weeks, orientation, start_date/end_date (or timedeltas), days_of_week_disabled/highlighted, dates_disabled, rtl, z_index_offset, and more. They are stored under the form display component's settings.

evals.prompt: What external JavaScript library does the Drupal bootstrap_datepicker module require for the calendar popup to appear, and where must it be installed?
evals.expected_output: It requires the uxsolutions/bootstrap-datepicker jQuery library installed at /libraries/bootstrap-datepicker (referenced by bootstrap_datepicker.libraries.yml, library id bootstrap_datepicker/datepicker). Without it the field still saves but the datepicker popup does not render.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has two Date/time fields, field_bsd_on and field_bsd_off. Exactly one of them uses the Bootstrap Datepicker widget on the default form display. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field uses the bootstrap_datepicker widget.
evals.expected_output: field_bsd_on uses the Bootstrap Datepicker widget: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component type is bootstrap_date_widget, whereas field_bsd_off uses the core datetime_default widget.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Date/time field field_bsd_fmt whose Bootstrap Datepicker widget has a specific display date format configured. Inspect the live default form display and report the configured 'format' setting value.
evals.expected_output: The configured format is dd/mm/yyyy: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_bsd_fmt component (type bootstrap_date_widget) has settings.format = 'dd/mm/yyyy'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Date/time field field_bsd_task currently using the default 'Date and time' widget on the default form display. Using the bootstrap_datepicker module, change that field's form-display widget to the Bootstrap Datepicker widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_bsd_task component has type = bootstrap_date_widget (e.g. set the component's widget type and save, or pick 'Bootstrap Datepicker' on Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Date/time field field_bsd_auto on the default form display. Configure it to use the Bootstrap Datepicker widget with the 'autoclose' option enabled (so the calendar closes when a date is picked). Apply the change to the live default form display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_bsd_auto component has type = bootstrap_date_widget and settings.autoclose is truthy (TRUE/1).
